notes.title: Railroad Expansion Update
notes.notes:
[h3]The Railroad Expansion Update is here![/h3][p][/p][p]Build a railroad across the Landscape or between you bases.
With a coal powered cart you are able to transport lots of items from point A to point B.[/p][p]The cart has it's own inventory that can be filled up.[/p][p]Four types of Rails (Left Turn, Right Turn, Uphill, Downhill) allow a dynamic track placement. [/p][p] [/p][h3]This Update also contains bug fixes![/h3][p]
- Rainbarrel water levels are saved
- Growth levels of planted crops are saved
- Multiplayer sound fixes
- Mulitplayer UI fixes
- Replaced the "Sharkheads" with more suitable Character
[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you for the Feedback!  [/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Hauntsville 1.1 (Content Update)
notes.notes:
[h3]The first content update is here![/h3]

- Better Performance
- 3 new Monsters
- More Action 
- Most of the crates and wooden boxes can be looted
- More loot
- New Buildings on the map
- Dismounting the storage box will drop its items instead of vanishing
- Golden Revolver fixed

[h3]Thanks for the feedback! If you like the updates please consider leaving a Review for Hauntsville, it helps a lot! [/h3]

[h3]Previous Patches:[/h3]

- Enemy AI is better at switching between base attacks and player attacks
- Enemy AI is faster at decision making
- Demons don't attack a dead player
- Improved NPC Spawn/Despawn System
- Scrolling through the hotbar to equip items is now possible
- Added a craftable standing torch to illuminate larger areas around the base
- Added a tent that allows you to sleep and save outside of the base when exploring
- Base Doors open easier
- Repair tutorial added to tutorial part of the Game (Press 'B' when looking at a base part to see HP)
- Changed some furniture collision boxes
- Shotgun reload bug fixed
- Deer don't despawn when player is nearby
- Floating Orbs can be looted for gunpowder
- Defense spikes damage enemies and don't block close gunshots
- Defense walls extend down further when placed to each other facing downhill (similar to foundation placement)
- Added invert mouse Y-Axis option
- Guns can't destroy the base anymore by accident
- If the chest gets destroyed the items inside will be dropped instead of vanishing

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
[h2]I made a quick update fixing some of the problems that have been reported so far[/h2]

- Short loading screen (4 seconds) for fast travel to prevent players from falling through the ground.
- Longer dismount time of 60 seconds for placed building parts. (Press X to remove placed part)
- Furnace doesn't overlap chest and can process Gold Nuggets to Gold Bars. 
- Audio levels of tools has been adjusted to be more balanced.

I will continue to make updates and try to fix reported bugs as soon as possible.
Things I will address in the next Update are:
- Performance
- Any other problems with overlaps of interactable items.
- Other bugs that are reported.

Thanks for your feedback.

notes.title: We have a Release Date and a Demo!
notes.notes:
Great News! Hauntsville will be available on March 10th and we have a new Demo for you to try out! Thanks for your patience! 🥳

[previewyoutube=iBJg74v6QVI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]🤠The Cursed West[/h2]
Hauntsville is a western horror survival game, set in the heyday of the American West. Build a homestead, search the haunted town for supplies or try to survive on what you can find in the wild, pursued by creatures straight from North American folklore!

[h2]⚒️ Fight, Explore, Build and Farm the lands[/h2]
In a dynamic environment with changing weather and dark nights, it is essential to have shelter. Use the resources available in the wild. Everything from trees, plants to wildlife and ores found in abandoned mines to help build your base and survive.  

[h2]❔ The Mystery[/h2]
Find out more about the disappearance of the population and the curse that lies upon the mountain valley. There is plenty of information left behind by fleeing inhabitants. Be careful! You never know what's lurking in the woods or behind the houses. 

[h2]📋 Wishlist the Game[/h2]
Wishlist the Game to get notified on release and don't forget to join our Discord and follow our socials!
